  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: A session following the header may attempt cleanup before the source issue identifier is available, leaving the stopped session visible.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Zombie-checker cleanup logic (Step 0 / Issue-mode resume) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The instructions do not define failure handling for transient errors in `mcp__github__issue_read` label reads or `set_session_title` renames.
  WHY: A failed rename can leave the session title unmatched, while a failed label read can skip archival without surfacing an error.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:187 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The header says “so stray checkers never pile up” although the section also handles issue-mode stopped stage sessions.
  WHY: An AI session reading the header first may plan only for checker cleanup and miss the issue-mode sub-bullet.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:107 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The rename-failure fallback does not name the MCP call needed to amend the existing `<!-- ai:claude-blocked:v1 -->` comment.
  WHY: Without naming the edit tool, a session could post a second comment instead of appending the rename-failure tail to the original.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:187-192 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup does not guard that the repository in the plan header's `Source issue:` line matches the running checkout.
  WHY: A successful cross-repo label read could cause the cleanup to archive a stopped session based on evidence from a foreign project.

- File: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: Step 0 bullet regarding "Issue-mode resume without a — resume. block" (line 12)
  Problem: The cleanup trigger is positioned as a child of Step 0 (Session preflight), but the instruction text requires the `Source issue:` identifier to run the cleanup, which is only resolved at Step 1 (Plan resolution).
  Why it fails at runtime: An unattended session following the step-by-step flow may attempt cleanup at the end of Step 0, before Step 1 has read the plan.   Why it fails at runtime: An unattended session reading the header first may attempt cleanup in Step 0, leading to a silent failure of the cleanup logic (as the source issue identifier is not yet available) and leaving the stopped session visible, thus re-introducing the bug this PR aims to fix.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: line 187 (Zombie-checker cleanup section header)
  Problem: The header sentence still reads "so stray checkers never pile up" while the section now also handles issue-mode stopped stage sessions. The wording understates the section's actual scope.
  Why it fails at runtime: An AI session reading the header first may plan only for checker cleanup and miss the issue-mode sub-bullet. The sub-bullet is reachable but the header does not flag it.
  severity=low
  confidence=[3]
- File: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: line 107 (rename-failure fallback, "end the blocker comment with `Stopped session: <session id> (rename failed; archive it by hand after the resume)`")
  Problem: The instruction does not name the MCP call needed to amend the existing `<!-- ai:claude-blocked:v1 -->` comment. CLAUDE.md §23.D item 4 mandates `mcp__github__update_issue_comment` for comment edits; without naming the tool, a session could post a second comment instead of editing the original, producing two `ai:claude-blocked` comments on the source issue (one missing the rename-failure tail).
  Why it fails at runtime: The session posts the blocker comment first (correct order), then retries the rename. Without naming the edit tool, the rename-failure fallback can land as a fresh comment rather than appending to the original, breaking the invariant that the rename-failure tail rides inside the first blocker comment.
  severity=low
  confidence=[3]
- File: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: lines 187-192 (Zombie-checker cleanup, "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions" sub-bullet, `mcp__github__issue_read get_labels`)
  Problem: The cleanup reads labels from the `<owner>/<repo>#<N>` parsed off the plan header's `Source issue:` line, with no documented guard that the issue's repo matches the running checkout.
  Why it fails at runtime: If the plan header names a `Source issue:` in a different repo (cross-repo plan, manipulated plan file), the read could succeed against the wrong repo and the cleanup would archive the stopped session on evidence from a foreign project. The fail-closed path only catches transport / permission failures, not a successful cross-repo read.
  severity=low
  confidence=[2]
